'''Bren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Section X]] area of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], investigating the wreckage of the ''[[Fatality]]'' cruiser in the [[Frozen Lake]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bren appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC in Section X, added in Update 1.5.
